race.title: Ryder & Cundall Designed To Go The Distance Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: CAVE BRIDGE made an encouraging handicap debut after 12 months off when sixth in a big field at Newbury and could be the answer with this longer trip expected to suit. The Kalooki Kid was rather unlucky to bump into one back in this sphere at Wetherby so rates the main threat ahead of the progressive Las Canals . CAVE BRIDGE (IRE) THE KALOOKI KID LAS CANALS (FR)
